import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, _split_text, cell_len
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style

def test_split_text_at_column_zero():
    """Split at column 0 should return empty string and full text."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"

def test_split_text_at_column_zero_with_double_width():
    """Split at column 0 with double-width characters should still work."""
    # Using ASCII for consistency
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"

def test_split_text_at_middle():
    """Split at middle position should still work."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    assert left == "he"
    assert right == "llo"

def test_split_text_at_end():
    """Split at or past the end should return full text and empty."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 5)
    assert left == "hello"
    assert right == ""
    
    left, right = split_text(text, 10)
    assert left == "hello"
    assert right == ""

def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero():
    """Segment.split_cells at column 0 should work."""
    segment = Segment("hello", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "hello"

def test_segment_split_cells_negative_raises():
    """Segment.split_cells with negative cut should raise AssertionError."""
    segment = Segment("hello", Style())
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        segment.split_cells(-1)

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, split_graphemes

def test_split_graphemes_single_cell():
    """split_graphemes should work with single-cell characters."""
    text = "abc"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 3
    assert total_width == 3

def test_split_text_empty_string():
    """Splitting empty string at 0 should return two empty strings."""
    left, right = split_text("", 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == ""

def test_split_text_negative_position():
    """Splitting at negative position should return empty and full text."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, -5)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"

def test_split_text_single_char():
    """Split single character at various positions."""
    text = "a"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "a"
    
    left, right = split_text(text, 1)
    assert left == "a"
    assert right == ""

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style

def test_segment_split_cells_zero_with_style():
    """Split at 0 preserves style on right segment."""
    style = Style(bold=True)
    segment = Segment("test", style)
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert left.style == style
    assert right.text == "test"
    assert right.style == style

def test_segment_split_cells_at_boundary():
    """Split at exact boundary between characters."""
    segment = Segment("ab", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(1)
    assert left.text == "a"
    assert right.text == "b"

def test_segment_split_cells_past_end():
    """Split past end should return full and empty."""
    segment = Segment("ab", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(10)
    assert left.text == "ab"
    assert right.text == ""
    assert right.style == left.style

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text

def test_split_text_mixed_widths():
    """Split text with mixed single and double-cell characters."""
    # Using only ASCII single-width for simplicity
    text = "abcde"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "abcde"
    
    left, right = split_text(text, 3)
    assert left == "abc"
    assert right == "de"

def test_split_text_sequence():
    """Multiple splits should work consistently."""
    text = "hello world"
    
    # First split at 0
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello world"
    
    # Split at different position
    left, right = split_text(text, 5)
    assert left == "hello"
    assert right == " world"
    
    # Split at end
    left, right = split_text(text, 11)
    assert left == "hello world"
    assert right == ""

import pytest
from rich.cells import chop_cells

def test_chop_cells_zero_width():
    """Chop with 0 width should handle gracefully."""
    text = "hello"
    result = chop_cells(text, 0)
    # With width 0, we should get chunks but none with positive content
    assert isinstance(result, list)

def test_chop_cells_single_cell():
    """Chop text with width 1."""
    text = "hello"
    result = chop_cells(text, 1)
    assert result == ["h", "e", "l", "l", "o"]

def test_chop_cells_wide_width():
    """Chop text with width larger than text."""
    text = "hi"
    result = chop_cells(text, 10)
    assert result == ["hi"]
